verdict.rationale: Heap lists "Account analytics" as a feature on its pricing page, and documents an endpoint for sending account properties such as payment tier, account owner, and account name for analysis. Together these show first-party account-level analysis, but how it works is barely described: a pricing bullet plus an ingestion API. missing for 10: documentation of account-level funnels/retention or behavioral reports, how users roll up to accounts, plan-tier limits on the feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can analyze behavior at the account or company level, not just per user, for B2B products

citations.quote: Account analytics • Engagement matrix • Report alerts
you should use this endpoint to send useful account properties for analysis (e.g. payment tier, account owner, account name, etc).
